attr.title: ReConflict
attr.desc: Experimental portable-GLES ARM64 ReConflict build. Requires SDL2, OpenGL ES and player-supplied English GOG build21657 files. Cross-device gameplay is unverified.
attr.inst: Put setup_conflict_-_desert_storm_1.0_(21657).exe in reconflict/ and launch ReConflict. No Python interpreter is required. The SDL launcher extracts and verifies the files, then offers to keep or delete the installer. Allow 2 GiB free before copying it. Tested firmware: 64-bit muOS on H700.
